name: Title and CTA
description: Show Title, sub title and CTA

attribute_definitions.name: Text Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the inner container of the component. Useful for overriding padding. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class directly to the title element to create space between the title and sub-title.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Font size(Mobile)
attribute_definitions.description: Sets title font size for mobile screens, default is 24px

attribute_definitions.name: Sub Title Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the inner container of the component. Useful for overriding padding. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Width
attribute_definitions.description: Set the width of subtitle, eg: '25%'

attribute_definitions.name: Sub Title Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sub Title font size, default is 16px

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Font size(Mobile)
attribute_definitions.description: Sets subtitle font size font size for mobile screens, default is 18px

attribute_definitions.name: Sub Title Alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Sub Title Alignment, default is unset

attribute_definitions.name: Select gird Only when using button alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Select grid property only when using button alignment, Otherwise leave it unchanged

attribute_definitions.name: Button Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the inner container of the component. Useful for overriding padding. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Button Style
attribute_definitions.description: Select button styling, default is btn-primary

attribute_definitions.name: Button Alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Select button Alignment, default is unset

attribute_definitions.name: CTA Aria-label
attribute_definitions.description: Aria-label is an attribute that provides an accessible name for screen readers helping users understand the purpose of an element.
